scenes.motion_prompt: Cinemagraph of an opulent Leo-themed bedroom, richly alive with continuous motion. The orange velvet canopy drapes and the sheer curtains billow and ripple noticeably in a flowing breeze. Warm afternoon sunlight pours through the window as soft volumetric god-rays. Golden dust particles and glowing bokeh sparkles drift and float slowly through the air, catching the light. A thin wisp of aromatic incense smoke curls and rises gently from the nightstand. The warm wall lamp flickers softly, its light dancing across the velvet bedspread and gold accents. The camera performs a very slow, subtle dolly with gentle parallax for depth, not a zoom. Luxurious, warm, magical yet calm atmosphere. No people in frame.
